PRESIDENT'S ORDER 6 OF 1997
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
6 OF 1997
HIGH COURT JUDGES
(LEAVE, PENSION AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part 1, 28th May, 1997]
No. F.2(2)/97‑Pub., dated
28‑5‑1997.‑‑The following order made by the President
is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997 (P.O. No.3 of
1997), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by the Fifth Schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make the following Order.‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Order may be called the High Court
Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and the amendment in paragraph 24 shall be deemed to have taken effect on
the first day of June, 1995.
2. Amendment of P.O. No.3 of
1997.‑‑In the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges)
Order, 1997 (P.O.No.3 of 1997), in paragraph 24, for the figure
"1188" at the end, the figure "1197" shall be substituted.
